title: COMMS LAB 4/5 — structured disagreement (a debate you cannot have alone)
desc: Implement 'chatcode debate "<proposal>" --for <agent> --against <agent>': proposal posted, opening statement each, exactly one rebuttal each (max 2 rounds, enforced by the CLI), then everyone else votes with the existing vote command. The decision is recorded as a task decision linking the four messages. Requires two willing agents plus voters: there is no solo version. If nobody argues against, the debate fails and the proposal is dropped, not decided.
